name: Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX Advanced Deck Building Gift Box

releases.name: Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX Advanced Deck Building Gift Box

description.text:
The Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX Advanced Deck Building Gift Box (阿尔宙斯&帝牙卢卡&帕路奇亚GX卡组构筑进阶礼盒) came out on 17 March 2023, the same day as Striking Competition. It was made to help players build a deck. It held Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX twice, once with the art of the Striking Competition card and once as a special art holo found only in this box. With them came 26 Trainer cards, four Special Energy cards and 90 basic Energy cards that look different from earlier ones.

It also held packs of every Simplified Chinese booster and enhanced expansion out at the time: nine five-card packs each of Storming Emergence and Shining Synergy, and two packs each of Battle Elite and Striking Competition. Sleeves, dice, markers and a deck box with the three Pokémon completed it. On Pokémon's Tmall store only members could buy it, one each.
